headline: Cboe To Hire Catherine Grover as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
summary: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe), a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity derivatives, today announced that Catherine Grover will join the company as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective November 16, 2026. In this role, Ms. Grover will oversee Cboe's global human resources function, focused on aligning Cboe's talent, organizational and workforce strategies to support the company's next phase of growth.
